properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1031708 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: USCG BASE KETCHIKAN
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1031708
Incident Time: 2012-11-27 07:00:00
Nearest City: Ketchikan, AK
Location: GALLEY BOILER ROOM 1300 STEDMAN STREET
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: USCG BASE KETCHIKAN
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 55.316667, -131.616667 (Explicit)
Reported Spill Volume: 1 gallons
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** THE GALLEY BOILER ROOM DAY TANK WAS OVER FILLED BY A MECHANICAL MEANS; OPERATOR ERROR WAS A CONTRIBUTING FACTOR, THUS CAUSING FUEL TO ESCAPE OUT OF THE DAY TANK AIR VENT. THE DAY TANK IS LOCATED INSIDE THE BOILER ROOM. THE COVER ON THE DAY TANK HAD SHIFTED AND WAS KEEPING A CUT OFF SWITCH WHICH STICKS OUT PAST THE COVER FROM FILLING THE DAY TANK SO WE RAN OUT OF FUEL FOR THE GALLEY BOILERS AND HOT WATER TANK. THIS MORNING THE OOD WAS CHECKING OUT WHY THE BOILERS WERE NOT RUNNING AND PLACED THE CLIP BOARD WITH THE SIGN OFF SHEETS ON THE DAY TANK COVER WHICH ALLOWED THE COVER TO SHIFT AND MOVE THE CUT OFF SWITCH FROM OFF POSITION TO ON. THE CUT OFF SWITCH WAS STUCK IN AN ON POSITION AND OVERFILLED THE DAY TANK. WE HAVE REMOVED THE COVER FROM THE DAY TANK AND WILL LOOK INTO REPLACING THE DAY TANK WITH A NEW ONE THAT DOESN’T VENT TO THE OUTSIDE.
